title: Ensure 'Require pin for pairing' is set to 'Enabled: First Time' OR 'Enabled: Always'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Connect\Require pin for pairing to 'Enabled: First Time' OR 'Enabled: Always'
reason: If this setting is not configured or disabled then a PIN would not be required when pairing wireless display devices to the system, increasing the risk of unauthorized use.
